time.decision: last actual XNYS close in each calendar week
time.execution: next actual XNYS session open; never same-bar

definitions.total_transaction_cost: total_commission_cost + total_slippage_cost; informational only because commission and slipped fill prices already affect equity
definitions.sortino_ratio: mean(daily_return-daily_rf) / sqrt(mean(min(daily_return-daily_rf,0)^2)) * sqrt(annualization); null when denominator is zero
definitions.corporate_actions: raw prices; dividends credited and splits applied at effective-session open before orders, based on the prior-close position
definitions.same_stock_benchmark: 100% long same symbol from first available next-open
definitions.SPY_benchmark: 100% long SPY from first available next-open
definitions.final_valuation: marked at configured final XNYS close; no forced liquidation
definitions.final_memory_archive: one-way byte copies of the final symbol-specific experiment Memory; read-only research artifacts that are never inputs to runtime or resume

memory_artifacts.memory/manifest.json: run, lineage, Graph, and symbol provenance plus per-file SHA-256; its own SHA-256 is bound into the top-level manifest
memory_artifacts.memory/symbols/<symbol>.md: exact final TradingMemoryLog state copied out of the operational runtime namespace

csv_files.inputs/market_data/<symbol>.csv: canonical exact raw OHLCV plus actions
csv_files.strategy/*: strategy decisions, orders, fills, actions and daily portfolio state
csv_files.benchmarks/*: benchmark artifacts with the same accounting policy
csv_files.analysis_ready/equity_curves.csv: long-form daily equity and normalized equity
csv_files.analysis_ready/decision_timeline.csv: one enriched row per weekly decision
csv_files.analysis_ready/case_index.csv: one row per TradingAgents decision case
csv_files.analysis_ready/data_availability.csv: one row per historical source-audit record
csv_files.analysis_ready/llm_usage.csv: one row per real LLM request using provider-reported usage

columns.Dividends: cash dividend per eligible share on the session
columns.Stock Splits: effective split ratio; zero means no split
columns.decision_session: session whose close generated the decision
columns.action: BUY, HOLD, SELL, or empty for a failed decision
columns.status: success, cached, failed, pending, filled, rejected, or noop
columns.execution_session: next XNYS session intended for open execution
columns.quantity: signed fill shares bought (positive) or sold (negative)
columns.fill_quantity: decision-timeline alias of signed fill quantity
columns.commission: cash commission charged on the fill
columns.slippage_cost: signed fill quantity times (fill price - raw open price); positive for the broker's adverse buys and sells
columns.equity: cash plus close-marked position market value
columns.realized_pnl: completed round-trip price P&L net of entry and exit commissions exactly once
columns.unrealized_pnl: open-position mark-to-fill-price P&L net of its entry commission
columns.cumulative_cost: compatibility alias for cumulative_transaction_cost; informational and not subtracted from equity again
columns.cumulative_slippage_cost: running sum of fill slippage costs
columns.cumulative_transaction_cost: running commission plus slippage; equity already bears both components
columns.normalized_equity: equity divided by the series first equity
columns.drawdown: signed decline from running peak (zero at a peak)
columns.cash_effect: cash credited by a corporate-action event
columns.strategy_forward_return: equity return from decision close to next evaluation close
columns.commission_cost_in_period: commissions on fills after the decision through period end
columns.slippage_cost_in_period: recomputed slippage on fills after the decision through period end
columns.transaction_cost_in_period: commission plus slippage on fills after the decision through period end
columns.average_exposure_in_period: mean daily position market value/equity in the period
columns.value: numeric metric value or empty when undefined
columns.case_id: stable identity of one symbol and decision-session Agent case
columns.decision_status: success, cached, or failed Agent decision status
columns.source_audit_path: run-relative path to the immutable source audit
columns.report_path: run-relative path to the immutable report tree
columns.cache_status: miss, hit, or bypass for the current case
columns.market_history_visibility: engine-owned audit of the exact strategy-visible history, including its maximum session, corresponding XNYS close time, row count, and SHA-256
columns.wall_clock_seconds: elapsed time for the current case materialization; cache hits measure replay
columns.graph_config_sha256: canonical hash of the research-affecting graph config
columns.agent_node: LangGraph node or Agent identity when provider metadata exposes it
columns.usage_source: live_request for a request made in this run; cache_origin for the preserved request that originally generated a replayed decision
columns.origin_run_id: run in which the provider request was actually made
columns.prompt_tokens: provider-reported input token count; empty when unavailable; case_index cache-hit totals describe the preserved origin request
columns.prompt_cache_hit_tokens: provider-reported cached input tokens; empty when unavailable
columns.prompt_cache_miss_tokens: provider-reported uncached input tokens; empty when unavailable
columns.completion_tokens: provider-reported output token count; empty when unavailable
columns.reasoning_tokens: provider-reported reasoning tokens; empty when unavailable
columns.total_tokens: provider-reported total token count; empty when unavailable
columns.latency_seconds: local monotonic request duration in seconds

input_return.source: frozen raw OHLCV plus session-local corporate actions
